title: Georges
body: Crafted from carefully selected carob pods, our Carob Molasses is a traditional Mediterranean syrup with a rich, naturally sweet flavor and a smooth texture. Made without added sugar, preservatives, or artificial ingredients, it is a wholesome alternative to refined sweeteners. Deeply rooted in Lebanese culinary heritage, carob molasses can be enjoyed as a spread, a natural sweetener, or an ingredient in both sweet and savory recipes. Drizzle over yogurt, labneh, or tahini Spread on bread or toast Sweeten beverages and smoothies Use in baking , desserts , and really good with chicken

title: Em’Ramiz
body: Overlooking the ancient Phoenician city of Sidon, Aabra enjoys a privileged setting between the Mediterranean Sea and the rolling hills of South Lebanon. For generations, its fertile lands have been shaped by sunshine, sea breezes, and a deep connection to the region's agricultural heritage. This olive oil comes from the Mushantaf family, who have carefully cultivated olive trees for two generations. Early-harvested to capture the olives at their peak, it reveals a vibrant and distinctive character. Crafted as a finishing olive oil, it is best enjoyed raw, where its richness and complexity can be fully appreciated.

title: Malvina
body: In South Lebanon, Deir Mimas unfolds among rolling hills lined with olive trees, some of which have stood for centuries. Named after Saint Mamas, a third-century shepherd said to have been protected by a lion, the village carries a quiet sense of history and resilience. Here, olive growing is more than a tradition; it is a rhythm of life, shaped by the land and passed down from one generation to the next. This olive oil comes from the Hasbani family, originally from Deir Mimas, where olive growing has been part of daily life for generations. Harvested at the end of September and beginning of October, it offers a fresh, balanced profile and is best used as a finishing touch, bringing out the natural flavors of each dish.

title: Costers
body: More than a coaster. A piece of Lebanon, wherever you are. Made from authentic Lebanese cedar, this coaster naturally carries the distinctive scent of Lebanon. Designed to bring the essence of Lebanese cedar to your table, wherever you are.

title: Fayez
body: Made from carefully selected grapes, our Grape Molasses is crafted using traditional methods to preserve its rich flavor and natural sweetness. With its smooth texture and deep fruity notes, it is a staple of Mediterranean cuisine, enjoyed for generations as a versatile and wholesome ingredient. Drizzle over tahini, yogurt, or labneh Spread on bread Sweeten desserts and pastries Add to marinades and dressings Stir in to beverages

title: Bri’ Zeit
body: Inspired by tradition, the Bri' shape evokes the old Lebanese “Bri' Zeit”, a saying that reminds us that history repeats itself. A classic form, passed down through generations, now reborn as a vessel for your everyday rituals.

title: Tantour
body: The Tantour is a modern choice, bold and independent. Inspired by the Lebanese princesses who wore tantours, it embodies loyalty, strength, and elegance in every curve.

title: Najibe
body: Set high in the mountains of North Lebanon, Douma is a village where landscape and heritage are deeply intertwined. Its terraces of olive trees reflect generations of agricultural tradition shaped by altitude, climate, and ancestral knowledge. This unique mountain environment gives rise to olives of distinctive character, producing an oil that balances freshness, depth, and authenticity. This olive oil is produced by the Chalhoub family, who have cultivated their groves for three generations. Harvested in November, it reveals vibrant aromas and is best enjoyed as a finishing touch, enhancing the natural flavors of each dish.
